name: Return to Lewis
summary: A crate of armor is bound for the People's Militia at Sentinel Hill, and Dungar Longdrink sends it from Stormwind by gryphon. The flight crosses Elwynn and Westfall to reach defenders under pressure.

sections.title: A Lifeline by Air
sections.body: Osric, an armorer in Stormwind's Old Town, has packed a heavy crate of armor for the People's Militia volunteers at Sentinel Hill. Defias bandits, hungry gnolls, and mechanical harvest reapers threaten Westfall. A lone wagon is an easy target on those roads, so the flight master network gives the armor a safer way to the defenders.

sections.title: The Ways of Gryphons
sections.body: Gryphons are loyal and well trained, but they need a known destination before they carry a rider there. Dungar Longdrink explains that they instinctively return to their capital roost in Stormwind. For a remote outpost, you first meet its flight master in person. You have already checked in with Thor at Sentinel Hill, opening the skies over the frontier to swift travel.

sections.title: Supplies for the Militia
sections.body: At Sentinel Hill, Quartermaster Lewis receives the crate and begins distributing its armor among the frontier defenders. He outfits Gryan Stoutmantle's volunteer force. Each shipment helps the militia hold its ground against the Defias Brotherhood.

faq.answer: Osric's Crate holds freshly made suits of armor arranged by the Stormwind armorer Osric. The People's Militia at Sentinel Hill urgently needs them. The volunteers lack standard royal supplies and rely on donations and private shipments for their gear.

Quartermaster Lewis is the People's Militia's supply officer, stationed beside the tower at Sentinel Hill. He manages rations, gear, and arms for volunteer defenders facing the Defias Brotherhood across Westfall.
Dungar Longdrink is Stormwind's veteran human gryphon master, at the roost in the capital's Trade District. He oversees the kingdom's aerial routes for couriers and passengers.

faq.q: Why do gryphons only fly to places you've already visited?
aliases: why must i visit thor first
faq.answer: Dungar says gryphons are trained to navigate straight back to the capital city. They rely on established waypoints and personal familiarity before carrying riders to remote frontier roosts like Thor's station at Sentinel Hill.
Thor is the flight master stationed at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. He tends the outpost's gryphons and receives aerial couriers from Stormwind.

faq.q: Why can't Stormwind just send royal wagons with supplies?
faq.answer: Defias bandits, Riverpaw gnolls, and thieves harass the roads between Elwynn Forest and Westfall. Overland supply trains risk ambush and confiscation, while the gryphon route is faster and safer.

angles.text: Gryphon routes between Stormwind and outlying settlements like Sentinel Hill help bind together a kingdom growing increasingly divided.
As a dwarf, you know gryphons as your people's ancestral mounts. The kingdom's aerial routes carry them from Dungar Longdrink's capital roost to Thor in Westfall.
As a warrior, you know each crate of breastplates and greaves flown to Sentinel Hill gives another militia fighter a chance to withstand blows from Defias brigands.
